name: BTC Exchange Stablecoins Ratio
description: (BTC Reserve) / (All Stablecoins Reserve). Ratio of BTC to cash on exchanges. High = more BTC than cash (illiquid buyers). Low = more cash than BTC (buyers have firepower).
trading_signal: Low (<0.1) → Extreme bullish (Massive buying power ready). High (>1.5) → Bearish (Few buyers, lots of sellers).
